headline: Weathered Expanse Redrawn; Mooring County Pierced as Casualties Soar
war_summary: Since the previous edition the Weathered Expanse has been redrawn: five works now stand Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, a reversal of the earlier Warden footing there, and it remains the busiest district of the day with sixty-three actions, six of them in the last two hours about Spirit Watch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest. Mooring County is no longer wholly Warden, eleven of its twelve works holding for the Warden side while one has passed to the Colonials; The Wind Hills alone saw twenty-five actions, with hourly casualties of roughly 483 Colonial and 325 Warden. The Nevish Line now stands even at four works apiece, its unclaimed ground gone, and reports the war's heaviest hourly toll at about 1,101 Colonial and 1,680 Warden. Linn Mercy holds eight Colonial works, two Warden and one unclaimed, with hourly losses near 1,121 and 1,620. Marban Hollow, four Warden to three Colonial with one unclaimed, has gone quiet since the small hours. Callahan's Passage, the costliest ground cumulatively, has cooled sharply. The map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
